params.centreline: the ego13 Isaac twin's frame-0 lay (rope_frame0), moved onto the bench with the twin's world and fitted onto this video's frame-0 rope (a 1.1 cm, 2.3 cm shift and a 7.0 deg turn about its centre; the robot's hand targets move with it)

simulation_model.approximation: segmented capsule chain (41 capsules on D6 ball joints, one PhysX articulation)

verification_plan.isaac_deformable_rest_check: the cord settles where it was laid (drift, connected chain, no self-overlap, on the table) and its settled tube matches the frame-0 mask through the camera

properties_covered.A thick, heavy, flexible rope: it bends: isaac_deformable_rest_check: a 41-link segmented rope that bends at every joint and does not stretch (locked joint translations)
properties_covered.Both ends carry short rigid brass ferrul: params: brass cap links at both ends (cap_length 0.075 m, cap_rgb)
properties_covered.Tying requires the rope to cross over it: the segmented_rope preset: rope-on-rope friction 0.6 and self-collision, so it crosses over itself and holds a knot (Stage 3 proves the tie)
properties_covered.The knot formed is a single overhand kno: Stage 3: the knot is proved on the executed episode

notes: The bench of setup/, seen through the ego13 Isaac twin's camera 'video' (fitted on this bench session's footage), moved onto the bench with the twin's world; the rope is the twin's asset (the fitted velvet-rope model, 41 links, 1.1148 m, 13.86 mm radius, brass caps) laid as the twin found it at its frame 0 (a second take of this task on the same day), fitted onto this video's frame-0 rope by a planar shift and turn, settled in Isaac Sim.
